provider: Strato HiDrive — 1 TB for 12 months at €0 (Valentine's promo)

free_tier.stated: 1 TB, 12 months, €0 (setup €0). Regular price after the free year is €5/month. Captured promo page states verbatim: 'HIDRIVE Basic | 1 TB | 12 Monate | 0 € | danach 5 €/Mon.' STATUS CAVEAT: the 2026 round closed on 15.02.26 ('Nur bis 15.02.26') and the live valentinsaktion URL now 301s away, so this is NOT orderable today — it is recorded as an annual recurring window (Feb), which is what makes it the slot's only repeatable >=1 TB free allocation.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: No per-file cap published on the plan page
per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: No traffic meter appears on the HiDrive plan page; the plan is sold on capacity only. Unverified whether egress is genuinely unmetered — Strato does not publish a traffic line for HiDrive, which in the German market usually means no byte meter.

tooling: rclone has a first-class 'hidrive' backend (added v1.59, Tier 1) — https://rclone.org/hidrive/ — plus plain WebDAV, SMB/CIFS, SFTP/FTPS and rsync-via-ssh. This is the best tooling of anything in this slot: a native rclone backend, not a webdav shim.
chaining: One promo contract per customer per year, but the promo is ANNUAL and structural — LowEndTalk users state 'They do this every year' (Feb 2024, Feb 2025, Feb 2026 all ran a 1 TB-for-a-year campaign). So the repeatability is temporal, not per-account: N years x 1 TB with a cancel-before-renewal ritual, or N household members x 1 TB.

limits.value: No per-file cap published on the plan page

limits_note: Contract term 12 months; auto-renews at €5/mo unless cancelled before expiry — this is the real trap and the reason it is 'trial-like'. Signup requires a full checkout with payment details (card/SEPA/PayPal) even at €0. No per-file cap published on the plan page.
reliability_note: Established German host (Strato/IONOS group), German datacentre, TÜV/DSGVO claims. The recurring failure mode reported on LET is billing, not data: forget to cancel and you are charged for year two. Data itself is not reported to vanish.
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.
